rounds.issues: UnifiedReward row mixed training tasks (3.51 is GenEval-trained; preference comparison is 3.66→3.74); DGPO surrogate sentence replaced the wrong object (must be the β log-ratio, not the bare log-density); NFT failure-mode sentence had β's role inverted (gradient ∝ β at d=0, ideal displacement ∝ 1/β); Q23 counterexample muddled; Q24 'CFG field corresponds to no marginal family' overstated; Q3 mis-applied EMA to Flow-GRPO's old. Plus: NFT efficiency is wall-clock per paper §4.3; 1.7k misattributed; 'SDE-only' scoped to training rollouts; Euler-discretised Gaussian; per-dim averaging gives ρ^{1/d}; std=0 ⇒ advantage 0.
